effect_description_eng:
＜Digisorption -3＞ (When one of your Digimon would digivolve into this card from your hand, you may suspend 1 of your Digimon to reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 3.)
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your ＜Digisorption＞ effect would suspend one of your Digimon, you may suspend your opponent's Digimon with that effect instead.
